Name: Harvest Moon Cow Replacement
Author: Chrysanthe
Description:
Cows were my favorite animals on Harvest Moon and I wanted to bring some of that cuteness to Stardew Valley.
This mod replaces the white cows with the regular cows from Harvest Moon.
They have also been altered slightly to fit onto the spritesheet.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/TukyrIy.png[/img]

The baby white cow is also available as a separate download!
Working on the brown cow replacements now! :)
[size=3]
[u]2/25/17 Update:[/u][/size]
A recolored version of the Harvest Moon Cow and Calf has been uploaded. The colors have been changed to better match the game's palette.
If you have any nice screenshots, please send them my way!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/isFXXK5.png[/img]

[size=3][u]5/7 Update:[/u][/size]
Uploaded a fix for the baby calf by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/44000237]bluestarkiller[/url] that had some weird pixels I missed in the last version. Thank you!
He also made a brown cow version [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1119/?]here[/url].


[b][u][size=3]Instructions:[/size][/u][/b]
. This mod replaces the original [i]White Cow.xnb[/i]. Please make a backup of the original file if necessary.
. Unzip or extract the [i]White Cow.xnb[/i] file after downloading.
. Place the file into the Stardew Valley folder under [i]Content\Animals[/i] and replace White Cow.xnb.
[i]
The BabyWhite Cow.xnb[/i] file is also in the same directory as the [i]White Cow.xnb[/i]. Make a backup if necessary before replacing.

Thanks for downloading!
